title: Bride & Groom Posed in Yard, 1930s Wedding Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a newly married couple posing on the lawn beside a clapboard home, circa late 1930s. The groom is dressed in a dark tuxedo with peaked lapels, a white dress shirt, and a black bow tie. The bride wears a stylish late-1930s bias-cut gown with a flaring trumpet hem, ruffled neckline, a short veil over finger-waved hair, and carries a voluminous flower bouquet with cascading ribbons. A budding or blossoming tree in the yard hints at a spring wedding during the late Great Depression era.
